## Docs

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [Code Distribution](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/community/code-distribution.md): Guidelines for distributing Custom Fields code
- [Contributing](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/community/contributing.md): How to contribute to Custom Fields
- [License](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/community/license.md): Dual-licensed under AGPL-3.0 for open source and commercial licenses for private applications
- [Support](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/community/support.md): Get help with Custom Fields
- [Authorization](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/authorization.md): Control access to the Custom Fields management interface
- [Builder Scoping](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/builder-scoping.md): Scope custom-field resolution to specific sections, and hook into code-uniqueness resolution
- [Configuration](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/configuration.md): Configure all aspects of the Custom Fields package
- [Data Model](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/data-model.md): Understanding the Custom Fields database architecture
- [Extending](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/extending.md): Filter which fields and sections a builder resolves, and extend the field form's schema
- [Field Types](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/field-types.md): Built-in field types and how to create custom ones
- [Import/Export](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/import-export.md): Learn how to import and export custom field data with import/export actions
- [Preset Custom Fields](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/essentials/preset-custom-fields.md): Programmatically define and deploy custom fields using migrations
- [Installation](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/getting-started/installation.md): Get started with Custom Fields in just a few steps
- [Quickstart](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/getting-started/quickstart.md): Get Custom Fields v3 working in your Filament project in under 5 minutes
- [Upgrade Guide](https://relaticle.github.io/custom-fields/raw/custom-fields/getting-started/upgrade-guide.md): Upgrade Custom Fields from v2 to v3
